supply: Official Raspberry Pi 27W USB-C, captive cable, Indian plug
pd_controller: Adafruit 5807 HUSB238, request 5V PDO over I2C
servo_enable_condition: 5V PDO negotiated at >=5A; GPIO16 pulls PCA9685 OE low only after verification
fallback: Outputs disabled and insufficient-power status if contract cannot be confirmed
